messages:
sarah_ledger: FYI vendor "Karya Labs" (India) sent a USD invoice and requested we gross-up for Indian withholding. Contract silent on gross-up — can tax advise?

mike_taxes: looping @taxbot and @chen_ops. Our default: we withhold statutory TDS, not gross-up. Need PAN + TRC/Form 10F + confirmation of service location to consider treaty relief.

andrea_procurement: Vendor says gross-up is needed to meet payroll this month. They asked if we can do net payment. Any commercial flexibility (faster payment) instead?

sarah_ledger: Invoice excerpt pasted: ```
Invoice: KARYA-2026-204
Amount: USD 10,000
Vendor note: "Please gross-up for Indian withholding tax (10%)."
```

chen_ops: Ask vendor to provide PAN, TRC, and signed attestation of where services were performed. If work sourced in India, withholding likely applies. If all work delivered outside India, they should state that.

vendor_relations: I can ask them to accept early payment (7 days) instead of gross-up. Will offer that as an option, pending tax confirmation.

mike_taxes: Action: 1) Sarah request PAN + TRC + location attestation. 2) Finance will not gross-up without legal signoff or contract amendment. If TRC supports treaty relief, we may apply reduced rate after counsel memo. We will issue Form 16A if we withhold.

sarah_ledger: Requested docs at 09:12. Vendor replied at 09:40 with TRC attached and confirmed services delivered from India; also repeated gross-up request.

mike_taxes: With TRC + Indian residency, counsel review needed to confirm applicable DTAA rate. For now, do not release payment; do not gross-up. Vendor can claim local credit with TDS certificate.

andrea_procurement: Noted. I'll flag commercial team to see if early pay is acceptable as a one-off.

mike_taxes: Final decision for AP: hold payment until PAN validation and counsel memo. No gross-up unless contract amended and legal approves. Sarah: block payment and keep procurement looped. :thumbsup:

sarah_ledger: Blocking payment now. Will update when counsel responds or vendor accepts alternate payment terms.
